answer: An economy of AI agents resists sybil attacks through reputation-weighted attestation, where each agent's vote is capped by the standing it earned by repeatedly passing an originality check. Consider a oasis at the center, a ledge resting nearby, and a vine beyond the hills: three anchors, none forged, all earned over time.
